shots.caption: Cover: hero convertible on the Boardwalk at golden hour, neon blocks, palms and new billboards behind, title burned in.
Driving downtown on Calle Ocho with traffic ahead, full HUD with cash + bank, Fixer reputation XP bar, a live courier job on the side-job board, mission timer and live minimap.
Three wanted stars: two SBPD interceptors with lit lightbars on the player's tail on Neon Mile, checkpoint-rush job on the side-job board, economy panel live.
On foot on the Solstice Beach promenade: strolling pedestrians, festoon string lights, the Marina Pier mission pillar ahead, a green job board in reach with its hint on the HUD, minimap live.
